about: Track A (v2.1) size ledger, plan qa-fixes §0 and §1 (V8 frozen table). /sim first download, KB gzip (1 KB = 1000 bytes, as check-budget prints). Each FP's T-step fills `measuredNet` (its merged /sim minus the /sim before it) and `measuredAt` when it merges. An FP over its planned net goes lazy before merging. check-budget prints this table and fails when /sim is more than netLimitKB over the base (R66: +1.0 KB, from T10).

main.about: v3 only (R61, W-1): main's own /sim, for check-budget's v3 vs main line. Update it when main merges into v3.

v3.about: v3 ratchets (R93 #8, #9), enforced by check-budget: a v3 build may not pass the last row's simRatchetKB (/sim first download, KB gz) or simEngineRatchetKB (/sim + the engine chunk). Each row: measured + 0.2 KB (/sim) and + 0.3 KB (/sim + engine). A WP that grows either adds its own row here with its measured sizes, after the council accepts it; nothing else moves a ratchet. The 194 KB /sim cap (R42) never moves.
